caveat: Every model PRC is the PRC of a fitted MODEL; the spontaneous estimate is a correlation. No fungus was stimulated.
rule: Chain rule (the chain_cycles template's first steps, b3_data.CHAIN_STEPS): rolling-mean detrend 600 s, noise_threshold 4 sigma below (sigma over the whole run span), minimum 30 s, merge 60 s, Event shape onsets; a train ends where a gap exceeds 3 h. A W3 chain 'continues past its span' only when its own-span train comes within 3 h of a span edge; it is then re-run on a span widened by 48 h each side (up to 4 times) until the train ends at least 3 h inside both edges, and the train holding the original train's events is taken. A new train (seq 122, MJu26a) is the chain rule's train around its seed span; fewer than 20 events = no train under the rule (not fitted).
